name: Home automation bridge
description: Bridge to a home-automation controller over its HTTP API. GENIE does not implement every bulb protocol — the controller owns the devices and this plugin speaks one stable interface to it. Capabilities are idempotent where a physical device demands it (no `toggle`), and every state change is verified by reading the entity back.

capabilities.name: entities
capabilities.description: List the entities the controller exposes
capabilities.verification: the entity list is read from the controller

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.verification: the state is read from the controller

capabilities.name: turn_on
capabilities.description: Turn an entity on (idempotent: already-on is a no-op)
capabilities.verification: the entity state is read back and confirmed on

capabilities.name: turn_off
capabilities.verification: the entity state is read back and confirmed off

capabilities.name: set_brightness
capabilities.verification: the brightness attribute is read back and confirmed

capabilities.name: activate_scene
capabilities.verification: the scene entity reports its last-activated timestamp

capabilities.name: reachable
capabilities.verification: a real request to the controller's API

author: GENIE
